g.text: Elastic curvature follows bending moment, with support conditions setting slope and deflection

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Linear Euler–Bernoulli beam with constant EI and small deflection; y-axis sign is upward positive, sagging moment positive, so EI v″=M for this coordinate
convention. v=0 at both supports; slopes are not zero there. Diagram deflection scale is exaggerated relative to span; shear deformation and support
